lines.t: I was a vessel broken, poured out on the ground
All I built in my strength had fallen down
The storm in my ways had ruined behind
Yet you came in the silence and opened my blind eyes
You has become my child to the place of still waters
My mercy flows freely for you are my treasure
Yahushua, my healer, my help, my light
You restore the pieces and make them right
Counselor of comfort, my soul's true friend
You breathe new life, I am whole again
I am whole again
You searched the depths where sorrow hides
And spoke peace where I could only cry
Your truth pierced through my shadow mind
Revealing the love I can never define
Now your voice resounds like thunder and flame
Yet wrapped in mercy, calling my name
Yahushua, my healer, my help, my light
You restore the pieces and make them right
Counselor of comfort, my soul's true friend
You breathe new life, I am whole again
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh I am whole again
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh Yeah
In the valley of ashes, you whisper rise Your hands rebuilt where the ruin lies
No wound too deep, no heart too torn For in your love, I am reborn
Yahushua, my healer, my hope, my guide You lift me high where grace abides
Spirit of truth, breathe through this clay You are my inspiration, my endless day
All that I am, You've written anew In mercy and power, I'm made through You
Broken, no longer, forever restored
Yeah, I wish you were my savior
Forever adored
